description: Source code for GPIO keypad scanner driver for ITE IT8XXX2 series in Zephyr RTOS, implementing GPIO configuration, port read/write, and device initialization.

methods.name: gpio_kscan_it8xxx2_configure
methods.description: Configures GPIO pin with specified flags, setting mode, pull-up/down, and open-drain as needed.

methods.name: gpio_kscan_it8xxx2_get_config
methods.description: Retrieves current configuration of a GPIO pin, including direction, pull-up/down, and voltage level.

methods.name: gpio_kscan_it8xxx2_port_get_raw
methods.description: Reads the raw port value from the hardware register.

methods.name: gpio_kscan_it8xxx2_port_set_masked_raw
methods.description: Sets multiple port pins to specified high/low levels based on mask and value.
